messages:
mike: Heads-up — spotted a 410 on an external schema link referenced in the runtime troubleshooting runbook (https://partner.example.com/schema/v2). It's causing our oncall play to show a broken link when we hit the KV cache incident flow.
lena: thanks for the catch. which page exactly? can you paste the line? :mag:
mike: runtime/troubleshooting.md, under 'kv cache mismatch' step. snippet:
```markdown
See partner schema: https://partner.example.com/schema/v2
```
The partner removed that endpoint and now returns 410. I grabbed an archived copy that matches what we relied on: https://archive.example.org/partner-schema-v2.json
anya: ugh. that runbook is referenced by platform-oncall runbook automation, so the broken link surfaces in the incident playbook UI. we should either swap to the archived copy or snapshot it into our KB.
sam: quick proposal: replace the external URL with our internal snapshot path under /kb/snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json and add a short note that it's a frozen copy with timestamp + source URL.
lena: +1. small PR is fine. can you include the sed one-liner to update and add a tiny footnote? saves a manual edit.
mike: done — opened a tiny PR with changes and a snapshot file: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987
PR summary:
- added snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json (archived copy)
- replaced external URL in runtime/troubleshooting.md
- added footnote: "This is an archived snapshot (2026-03-18) of partner schema v2. If partner restores a public endpoint, update and reference canonical URL."
sed command in the PR description for quick local patch:
```bash
sed -i "s|https://partner.example.com/schema/v2|/kb/snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json|g" runtime/troubleshooting.md
```
anya: thanks — assigning to me for review. pinging @lena to sanity-check wording for the footnote.
lena: LGTM on wording, maybe add one line about when to rotate the snapshot (e.g., every 6 months) — but not required for this tiny PR.
platform-oncall: FYI — once merged, I will rerun the runbook preview to confirm the UI no longer shows the broken link. :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: CI linkcheck ran for the PR — found no new 4xx on docs build stage. (flake: image serve event unrelated)
sam: quick Q — should we also add a short note into the runbook changelog entry so future oncall folks know why the snapshot exists?
mike: will add a 1-line changelog entry in the PR body and squash it in. thanks all.
anya: Reviewing now, aim to merge before EOD. If anyone wants to co-review quickly, drop a :eyes: on the PR.
lena: :eyes:
mike: thx. will follow up once merged and platform-oncall confirms the preview is clean.
platform-oncall: confirmed after merge — runbook preview no longer surfaces the broken partner link. closing thread. :tada:
